exceptions.description: The selected primary sources are documented but exact intersecting bytes and metadata snapshots are not locally acquired or hash-pinned.
exceptions.resolution: Generate deterministic inventories, download exact artifacts resumably, verify embedded CRS/datum, and record SHA-256, byte length, and acquisition time.

exceptions.description: Municipal footprint height attributes derive from 2010 data, while the 2025 LiDAR building class has weaker QA/QC than its ground class.
exceptions.resolution: Conflate footprint timestamps, 2025 surface returns, permits, and imagery; flag rather than invent unresolved roof forms.

exceptions.description: Oakland edge and SFO approaches exceed municipal coverage, and no exact Overture release or ODbL publication design is approved.
exceptions.resolution: Select and hash a bounded release, retain feature-level lineage, and obtain approval for derivative-database distribution and notices.

exceptions.description: Orthophotos provide roofs and ground appearance, not lawful street-facing textures at the required density.
exceptions.resolution: Acquire separately licensed facade references or use deterministic procedural materials; do not project consumer street imagery.

exceptions.description: No approved game-ready models exist for the required bridges, towers, civic landmarks, Alcatraz, cable cars, and piers.
exceptions.resolution: Acquire exact licensed models or build explicitly labeled proxies that pass position, height, silhouette, span, and clearance checks.

exceptions.description: Regional ferry-route data requires an API token and unresolved agreement review.
exceptions.resolution: Approve and pin a dated GTFS snapshot, or derive visibly labeled non-schedule route corridors from an approved geographic source.

exceptions.description: No terrain, imagery, geometry, collision, navigation, 3D Tiles, CDN, signing, or rollback artifacts exist.
exceptions.resolution: Run the pinned pipeline after inputs clear preflight, then stage content-addressed artifacts and verify public HTTP behavior before catalog activation.

exceptions.description: No named physical-GPU frame evidence or required human license and visual approvals exist.
exceptions.resolution: After the release candidate is immutable, run all traversal and soak suites on named hardware and attach signed raw evidence plus two-person approvals.
